title: Miyata Kard Market: Delta Reign ETB now shows sold out, second wave due 17 Nov
detail: Page marks the Elite Trainer Box (€79.99) 'Épuisé'; only the 6-booster bundle (€44.99) is clearly 'En vente'. Tripack, Display 36 and single booster are listed as 2nd-wave pre-orders arriving 17/11/2026, but their stock labels are inconsistent, so availability is unconfirmed.

title: Mega Greninja ex League Battle Deck: date now disputed (11 or 13 Nov)
detail: ICv2 reported 11 Nov, another listing (OTIA) says 13 Nov. Neither confirmed by Pokémon officially; ask a Réunion shop before counting on it.

title: This Saturday 14 Nov: Pokémon Special Event Buenos Aires and four One Piece regionals
detail: One Piece regionals in Bristol, São Paulo, Niagara Falls and Knoxville. Porto/Sydney (7 Nov) results are still not on Limitless (its One Piece list still ends 26 Jul), so winners are unconfirmed.

title: OP-18 is 8 days away: English 20 Nov, Japanese 21 Nov
detail: Retailer calendar gives EN 20 Nov ($4.99/pack) and JP 21 Nov (¥240/pack), plus Gift Collection Heroines on 20 Nov. French release date still unconfirmed (pre-releases 21–28 Nov).

title: Price check: still no 20% moves
detail: TCGdex Cardmarket 7-day vs 30-day: Mew ex 152 €82.68 vs €88.71 (−7%); Pikachu ex 150 €50.74 vs €54.16 (−6%); Gengar ex 154 €63.94 vs €67.35 (−5%); Morpeko ex 117 €48.02 vs €51.90 (−7%); Jirachi €32.25 vs €33.41; Sylveon €33.09 vs €33.36. Slide is slowing.
